_worked_example: INTERRUPT. GDD §19.5's first of three. Second rung of the soft-cap telegraph. It interrupts because a reporter on the phone is a person waiting, and because by this point the clock is close enough that the player should hear it stop being ambient. Both options cost something real and neither is the wise one.

tr.title: Yorum istiyorlar
tr.body:
Telefondaki kişi kibar. Yıl sonu derlemesi için birkaç satır istiyor; senin turundan kalan birkaç şirketten biri sensin ve bu onun için bir hikâye.

Bir rakam versen dosyaya girersin. Vermezsen de girersin, sadece başka bir cümleyle.

en.title: They want a comment
en.body:
The person on the phone is polite. They want a few lines for the year-end round-up; you are one of the few companies left from your cohort, and to them that is a story.

Give them a number and you are in the piece. Refuse and you are in it anyway, under a different sentence.
